newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland Bank drains FIM 2.30 bln at 3.10 pct rate.
newsitem.headline: Finland Bank drains FIM 2.30 bln at 3.10 pct rate.

text.p: The Bank of Finland on Wednesday drained 2.30 billion markka of spot liquidity in an auction of one-month paper at the new 3.10 percent tender rate it set in the morning.
Before the opening, the central bank forecast a spot liquidity surplus of 9.90 billion markka. The required daily balance for banks was 3.10 billion markka.
The Bank of Finland's tender rate -- its chief monetary policy tool -- was lowered to 3.10 percent from 3.25 percent on on Wednesday morning.
